title: Cost cascade filter flow — visual polish, interaction redlines, and QA handoff
creator: Rina Kapoor
description:
Summary: This ticket covers the final visual polish, interaction redlines, and QA handoff for the new ‘cost cascade’ pattern in the Console. The cost cascade is a hierarchical filter & preview panel that lets users drill from account → project → model → rollout and see an immediate cost delta preview. The goal is to make multi-level filtering discoverable, performant on large orgs, and accessible (keyboard + screen reader).

Design goals and decisions: 
- Prioritized a filter-first breadcrumb that preserves applied filter state across navigation (decision: persistent filters vs ephemeral filters). Persistent filters reduce rework for platform teams but require clear UI affordance — added an inline chip bar + a persistent compact header.
- Introduced a lightweight cost-delta microcard in the cascade that surfaces 3 metrics (median latency, 7d cost delta, projected monthly) with color-blind-safe palettes. Color usage pairs with iconography to avoid reliance on color alone.
- Performance trade-off: to support orgs with 30k+ rollouts we use server-side pre-aggregations for top-level previews and lazy-load second-level details. This requires a small backend flag (beta: cost-cascade-lazy-load) — noted in dependencies.

Prototype & artifacts: 
- Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/cost-cascade-2025 
- Interactive prototype (Framer): https://framer.com/proto/REDACTED/cost-cascade-proto 
- Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/REDACTED/Cost+Cascade+PRD 
- GitHub PR (visual CSS + small console nav change): https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4123 
- Telemetry dashboard (internal): https://monitoring.redwood.ai/d/cost-cascade/overview 

Stakeholder feedback (synthesized): 
- PM (Avery Kim): +1 for persistent filters; requested an explicit 'clear all' in top-left and an undo toast when filters reset.
- Backend Eng (Noah Lin): flagged the need for server-side pre-agg and a scalable pagination strategy for second-level nodes; recommended a feature flag rollout.
- Security & Compliance (Lara Svensson): asked for copy and visual affordances to differentiate 'estimated' vs 'billed' cost where cost data comes from external billing systems. Added a badge and tooltip copy.
- Accessibility review (internal): keyboard walkthrough passed for primary flows; screen-reader strings need refinement for the cascade expand/collapse (see QA checklist).

Redlines and visual polish items delivered in this ticket: 
- Adjusted chip spacing to 8px horizontal (was 10px) and reduced left padding on cascade rows by 6px to improve density.
- Increased hit target for expand chevrons to 36px and introduced hover state with 8% neutral overlay.
- Reworked microcard typography: 12/14/14 for label/value/metric to align with Console scale and improve scan.
- Recolored delta indicators to pattern-safe palette: success/neutral/risk with accompanying caret icons.

QA checklist (handoff): 
- Interaction fidelity: expand/collapse with keyboard (Enter & Space), focus visible for chips and chevrons.
- Screen reader: ARIA labels for each cascade node and a summary live-region announcing applied filter deltas.
- Visual regression: compare snapshot for small/medium/large density and dark mode.
- Telemetry: events for filter apply/remove, node expand, and microcard click (projected vs details).
- Edge cases: single-node org (no cascade), >200 child nodes (ensure pagination UI present), and missing billing permissions (show 'insufficient permissions' state).

Decisions logged during review: 
- Keep cost delta microcard read-only in first wave to avoid coupling edit flows; edit actions will be separate in a follow-up ticket.
- Mark feature gated behind 'cost-cascade' remote config, staged rollout: 10% → 50% → 100% based on telemetry health.

Dependencies and blockers: 
- Backend work: ENG-21420 (pre-aggregation endpoints) — dependency noted.
- API flag for lazy-loading: ENG-22031 — must be merged before canary rollout.
- Copy review for 'estimated' vs 'billed' by Legal — blocker for GA.

Next steps and acceptance criteria: 
- Design sign-off (this ticket) after the small copy tweaks and ARIA string updates are implemented.
- Dev: merge GH PR #4123 and enable feature-flag in staging.
- QA: run checklist and sign off on platform-qa@redwood.ai.
- Release plan: gated rollout with telemetry thresholds (error rate increase < 0.5%, median number of API calls per page < 1.6x baseline).

Notes: This ticket is intentionally focused on the UX finish and handoff; feature expansion (inline edits, forecasting experiments) will be separate tickets.
